name: cli_mouse_selection_repair

test_list.description: Three clicks select source line including existing LF.
Word drag preserves anchor word and extends to complete target word.
Mouse range is deleted after release and restored with undo.
Padding does not retain or start text selection.
Only current surface owns text selection.
Visible footer and picker row click enters Demo.
Question editors share mouse selection semantics.
Reverse word drag retains whole source units.
Triple-click spans one logical source line across visual rows.
Padding has no selectable word or line source.
Reverse Unicode selection is deleted exactly and late copy does not alter it.
Replacement consumes the selected word and Undo restores it.
Notes and main composer ownership remain isolated.

output_description: Bounded text selection, local profile and editor mutations or explicit input errors
